svg.title: Thirty days to a reviewable recovery operation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-30-day-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty days to a reviewable recovery operation; subtitle: Readiness milestones, not a payout schedule; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end-days. Ranges are operating targets, not statutory filing periods or expected collection dates.; caption: The month should end with documented cases, actual spending and a decision on the next cohort; a pending distribution is not collected revenue.; stages: label: Select one lane; value: Days 1-7; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose one county and sale type; identify the custodian, claim procedure, compensation rules and deadlines.; label: Build the case desk; value: Days 8-14; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure record provenance, duplicate checks, engagement documents, case budgets and a deadline calendar.; label: Screen a pilot cohort; value: Days 15-21; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Verify balances, trace ownership and record rejection reasons before committing to expensive evidence work.; label: Review and iterate; value: Days 22-30; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Review evidence completeness, professional-review needs and cash runway; resize the next cohort using measured costs.
